on the hit, 4 base magma-ball projectiles launch in varied directions, travel 2-25 units, and land SIMULTANEOUSLY, each hitting a circular splash area around its landing point (60% less damage per ball); against a big single target the balls OVERLAP on it -- the boss-shotgun identity

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: COMPOSITE melee->projectile-RAIN strike (b04 frost-blades two-geometry precedent; melee leads per s7.2). The Uber-Elder-era boss-killer identity is the OVERLAP: 4+ balls landing in overlapping splash circles on a single large target multiply single-target damage -- an emergent property of multi_projectile + splash noted, not enumerated. 60% phys->fire (dossier verbatim) -> ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL; hit-spawns-projectiles -> GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade (b04 frost-blades exact routing). Era 3.0-3.6 CONFIRMED (added 1.1.3; the 3.7 hit-requirement redesign postdates the kit's throne era but is the verified modern mechanism -- mapped with the hit-gated spawn per dossier). Rooted movement posture (movement facts: 'stand'/rooted) folded into motion_frame; commit stays instant (the melee swing commits, the rain is automatic).
